module_summary: Build files and headers of ee_core, the in-game EE resident (upstream Open PS2 Loader, heavily extended) that ps2build builds from ps2.yaml:604-613 and embeds in the menu ELF. coreconfig.h (EECoreConfig_t), modules.h (OPL_MODULE_ID_* blob table), igrcheats.h and igrovl.h are contracts shared with the menu (src/platform/system.cpp, src/app/host.cpp, src/core/cheatman.cpp include them). The rest declare ee_core internals: kernel/SIF hooks (asm.h, syshook.h), IOP reset and module loading (iopmgr.h, modmgr.h, reset_arg_bounds.h), pad hook and IGR (padhook.h, padpatterns.h), GSM, cheats, IGS, RetroAchievements, the in-game menu and its overlay (igrovl/), and the INGAMEDIAG freeze report. ee_core/linkfile places everything in ram84 (0x84000-0x97000) and asserts a 3 KB stack; ee_core/Makefile is the legacy make build.

reusable_helpers.name: find_pattern_with_mask
reusable_helpers.what: search a word buffer for an instruction pattern under a mask (defined in ee_core/src/util.c)

reusable_helpers.name: CopyToIop
reusable_helpers.what: copy an EE buffer into IOP memory over SIF DMA

reusable_helpers.name: _strcpy/_strcat/_strcmp/_strncmp
reusable_helpers.what: libc-free string copy/concat/compare used inside ee_core

reusable_helpers.name: WipeUserMemory
reusable_helpers.what: zero a range of EE user memory

reusable_helpers.name: igrCheatsBuild
reusable_helpers.what: build the cheat engine's [count][pairs] code set from ticked rows; shared by menu (cheatman.cpp) and ee_core (cheat_api.c)

reusable_helpers.name: eeResetPayloadLength
reusable_helpers.what: bounds-check an intercepted SifResetIop packet payload length

reusable_helpers.name: strlen
reusable_helpers.what: minimal libc-free strlen for the igrovl overlay

findings.title: In-game DECI2 debug mode (__DECI2_DEBUG) is dead: no ps2build configuration defines it and its IRX blobs are never embedded
findings.problem: __DECI2_DEBUG is set only by the legacy make files (Makefile:340, ee_core/Makefile:44); tools/build_configuration.py (debug configs at :79-100) never adds it and ps2.yaml/tools never embed drvtif/tifinet/deci2. So OPL_MODULE_ID_DRVTIF/TIFINET, the iopmgr.c load branch and all menu-side DECI2 code (ResetDECI2, sysInitDECI2, CORE_IRX_DECI2) cannot be built by the real build; the 5 blobs (drvtif.irx and drvtif-ingame.irx are byte-identical) serve only the legacy deci2_debug target.
findings.fix: Delete the __DECI2_DEBUG branches (keep the #elif TTY_UDP/TTY_PPC bodies as the #if), CORE_IRX_DECI2 and its masks, sysInitDECI2/ResetDECI2, and modules/debug/deci2.img, drvtif*.irx, tifinet*.irx. Leave OPL_MODULE_ID_DRVTIF/TIFINET in modules.h only if renumbering the later IDs is unwanted; otherwise delete them too (menu and core share the header and rebuild together).
findings.benefit: ~100 source lines (INFERRED from the cited #ifdef ranges) and 92,197 bytes of committed blobs (MEASURED: ls -la modules/debug: 73625 + 2x5985 + 2x3301). No shipped ELF change: nothing here is compiled today.
findings.evidence: grep __DECI2_DEBUG over *.py *.yaml *.yml Makefile *.sh: only ee_core/Makefile:44, Makefile:340 and tools/syntax_sweep.py:23 (a -fsyntax-only sweep, no link). grep drvtif/tifinet over ps2.yaml, tools/*.py, *.yml: none; only legacy Makefile:310,342,1182-1194. cmp drvtif.irx drvtif-ingame.irx: identical. build_configuration.py:79-100 read: debug configs add __DEBUG/TTY_*/__INGAME_DEBUG/__LOAD_DEBUG_MODULES only. system.cpp ranges located by grep and #if/#endif scan, not read line by line (INFERRED part); iopmgr.c:176-194 read.

findings.title: ee_core/Makefile is a stale legacy build: ps2build builds eecore from ps2.yaml, and this file no longer matches it
findings.problem: The real eecore target is ps2.yaml:604-613 plus the overlays in tools/build_edition.py/build_configuration.py. ee_core/Makefile is reached only from the legacy top-level Makefile:572-574 (no workflow runs it) and has drifted: no IGR_MENU define or igrmenu.o/igrmbox.o (ps2.yaml:606,609), RA adds ra.o ra_overlay.o but not ra_pulse.o although ra_overlay.c:378 calls RA_PulseOnVblank (ra_pulse.c:73), and no freeze_diag/igrovl objects. clean and clean_all (95-99) are identical.
findings.fix: Delete ee_core/Makefile together with the legacy top-level Makefile, and drop the two doc mentions. If the top-level Makefile stays for now, at least delete this file's dead DECI2/TTY_PPC knobs; it already cannot reproduce a shipped build.
findings.benefit: 101 lines removed (MEASURED: file length); no ELF change, the file is not used by ps2build.
findings.evidence: Read ps2.yaml:600-640 (eecore sources/defines). grep 'ee_core/Makefile' repo: Makefile:240 (comment), docs/GSM.md:213, docs/RETROACHIEVEMENTS-INTEGRATION-PLAN.md:165,259,531; no workflow/tool/test. grep make in *.yml/*.sh/*.py: only flavours.yml:374-375 (bdmassault), tools/lng_pack.sh (make oplversion), build_rolling_extras.sh (no workflow caller per brief). ls ee_core/src: ra_pulse.c, igrmenu.c, igrmbox.c, igrovl_stub.c, freeze_diag*.c exist but are absent from EE_OBJS (Makefile:16-21,63). Link failure of legacy RA build is INFERRED, not built.

findings.title: igs_api.h: unused register macros, a dead duplicate set of GS register numbers and a BMP hex-dump comment
findings.problem: GS_BITBLTBUF/TRXPOS/TRXREG/TRXDIR/FINISH (35-39) are never used: igs_api.c uses the identical GS_GSBITBLTBUF..GS_GSTRXDIR at 91-95, and igrmenu.c (which does not include igs_api.h) defines its own copies at 687-690. GS_D1_TADR/ASR0/ASR1, GS_IMR, GET_PMODE_EN1, GET_SMODE2_INT/FFMD/DPMS, GET_DISPFB_DBX/DBY have no use anywhere. 148 and 168-176 are a sample BMP pixel dump in comments.
findings.benefit: ~25 lines removed; macros only, no ELF change (header compiled in IGS extras builds via build_configuration.py:40 and padhook.c:39).
findings.evidence: Whole-repo token scan (all text files incl. .S, .py tests, Makefiles) for each macro: GS_FINISH, GS_D1_TADR, GS_D1_ASR0, GS_D1_ASR1, GS_IMR, GET_PMODE_EN1, GET_SMODE2_INT, GET_SMODE2_FFMD, GET_SMODE2_DPMS, GET_DISPFB_DBX, GET_DISPFB_DBY: only their definition. GS_BITBLTBUF/TRXPOS/TRXREG/TRXDIR: igs_api.h:35-38 and igrmenu.c uses, which resolve to igrmenu.c:687-690 (igrmenu.c includes list at :42-52,107 has no igs_api.h). GS_GS* at 91-95 used by igs_api.c:222-230.

findings.title: ListModules (EESIO debug) has no caller
findings.problem: ListModules is defined under __EESIO_DEBUG and prototyped in modmgr.h, but nothing calls it: the only matches in the repo are the definition and the prototype.
findings.fix: Delete the function (with its banner and #ifdef) and its prototype.
findings.benefit: 24 lines removed; only compiled in the unshipped eesio_debug configuration (ee_core links without --gc-sections, so that build carries the dead code, INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Whole-repo token scan for ListModules: ee_core/include/modmgr.h:95 and ee_core/src/modmgr.c:269 only. Read modmgr.c:262-285. ps2.yaml:613 eecore ldflags have no --gc-sections.

findings.title: Small dead declarations in ee_core headers (Remove_Padhook prototype, DEV9 register macros, unused glyph/struct/asm constants)
findings.problem: Remove_Padhook is prototyped but defined nowhere. DEV9_R_1460..1474 are used by no ee_core file (cdvdman/dev9.c uses the SDK's own DEV9_R_* names). IGR_LIBPAD_NONE, G_POINTER, the forward declaration struct igr_cheats (igr_cheats_t is an anonymous struct), the .equ GS_BGCOLOUR and SMODE2_adaptation are never referenced; coreconfig.h:12 is a commented-out include.
findings.benefit: ~14 lines removed; declarations only, no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Whole-repo token scan (C/C++/headers/.S/.py/Makefiles): Remove_Padhook only padhook.h:25; DEV9_R_146C, DEV9_R_146E only padhook.h; DEV9_R_1460/1464/1466/1474 elsewhere only in modules/iopcore/cdvdman/dev9.c, which does not include padhook.h; IGR_LIBPAD_NONE, G_POINTER, igr_cheats, SMODE2_adaptation: definition only. GS_BGCOLOUR outside gsm_defines.h only as the C macro in ee_core.h:88-91, not in any .S.

findings.title: Menu/ee_core constants declared twice: unused COMPAT_MODE copies in ee_core.h and patches.h; cheat limits and code_t also in cheatman.h
findings.problem: COMPAT_MODE_1/2/5/7/8 in ee_core.h are used by no ee_core file (the menu uses its own iosupport.h copy), and patches.h:14 repeats COMPAT_MODE_4 although its only includer (syshook.c) never uses it and patches.c gets it from ee_core.h. MAX_HOOKS/MAX_CODES/MAX_CHEATLIST/MAX_IMAGEWORDS and code_t, which define the cheat list the menu hands ee_core, exist in cheat_engine.h/cheat_api.h and again in cheatman.h, and igrcheats.h:26 hard-codes MAX_CODES a third time.
findings.fix: Delete ee_core.h:59-60,63,65-66 and patches.h:14. Optionally move the four cheat limits and code_t into igrcheats.h (plain C, already included by cheatman.cpp and ee_core), use them for IGR_CHEAT_SET_CODES, delete both other copies and point .github/scripts/test_cheat_capacity.py at igrcheats.h.
findings.justification: The optional move only relocates existing definitions to the one header both sides already include; it removes two copies of a cross-program size contract that must stay equal (cheatman.cpp fills MAX_CHEATLIST words that cheat_api.c:87 walks).
findings.benefit: 6 lines removed for the COMPAT part; ~14 more with the optional cheat move. Macros only, no ELF change.
findings.evidence: Grep COMPAT_MODE_[0-9] over ee_core: uses only of 3 (asm.S, own define), 4 (patches.c:999), 6 (main.c, syshook.c, asm.S). patches.h included only by ee_core/src/syshook.c:15. Read include/cheatman.h:30-70 and include/iosupport.h:94-106. Menu already includes ee_core headers (src/core/cheatman.cpp:29 igrcheats.h; src/platform/system.cpp:47-48). test_cheat_capacity.py:22-24 slices cheatman.h from CHEAT_VERSION to gCheats and compiles it, so it needs updating with the move.

findings.title: RA_PROBE lab probe ladder left in ee_core: always 0, no build sets it
findings.problem: ra.h defines RA_PROBE 0 'in every real build' for a lab experiment (X-Men Origins hunt, iopmgr.c:238-241); no ps2.yaml, tools/*.py, workflow or Makefile ever defines it, so every RA_PROBE test is a constant and the comments describe modes nobody can select.
findings.fix: Delete the RA_PROBE define and comment, the lab comment in iopmgr.c, and drop the RA_PROBE terms from the conditions (the code they guard stays as if RA_PROBE were 0).
findings.benefit: ~12 lines removed; constant-folded today, so no ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Whole-repo token scan for RA_PROBE: ra.h:9-10, iopmgr.c:238,244,246,342, ra.c:242,244,290,368,369,395, and two host tests that #define RA_PROBE 0 in their own stubs (test_ra_launch_resources.py:40, test_ra_runtime_budget.py:55). grep RA_PROBE in *.yaml/*.yml/*.py tools/Makefile: no definer.

findings.title: ee_core/debug_colors_doc.sh: doc generator that nothing runs and whose output is not in the repo
findings.problem: The script greps DBGCOL/DBGCOL_BLNK calls into a Markdown colour table, but no workflow, tool, doc or Makefile mentions it, and its output heading appears nowhere else in the repo.
findings.evidence: Grep 'debug_colors_doc' over the whole repo: no matches. Grep 'Color automated documentation|Static Debug Colors': only the script itself. ee_core.h:89 notes DBGCOL exists so it can be grepped for docs; the macros stay in use (53 call sites), only the generator goes.
